Preserving Rarites begins the Secrets of Azeroth event properly. To start, head to the Roasted Ram inn of Valdrakken, marked by the Secrets of Azeroth event icon on the zone map: :The Secrets of Azeroth are being uncovered by a select few in the Roasted Ram inn.
Preservationist Kathos is a dracthyr located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken. She is the central character behind the Secrets of Azeroth event.

Preservationist's Locker is a chest belonging to Preservationist Kathos. It is located at behind a bed on the second floor of the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken. Fangli's Note, awarded from An Inside Job? part of the third day of Secrets of Azeroth activities, offers hints of its exact location. Open it with the Copied Artifact Storage Key, also provided by the quest. Take out the Maruuk Burial Banner, then bring it to "Appraiser" Sazsel Stickyfingers at south of the Seat of the Aspects to have it appraised, then return it to the locker for Preservationist Cleared.
]] Preservationist Cleared concludes the third day of Secrets of Azeroth activities.

The name Prestor has been used by two black dragons: *Lord Daval Prestor, alias of the black Dragon Aspect Deathwing. **Lord Daval Prestor II (beta NPC) *Lady Katrana Prestor, formerly a prominent NPC in Stormwind Keep (removed as of patch 3.0.2).
A priest set refers to a collection of equipment with a priest class restriction that usually provides an additional bonus when worn together.

These are discussions of the salient points of each Priest quest. This page contains Spoilers. If you want to figure these out on your own, do not read this page. While these are not step by step walkthroughs they do hit all the high points and give an outline to completion.

Priestess Delrissa is the third boss in the Magisters' Terrace instance. She comes with four NPCs, randomly chosen, similar to Hex Lord Malacrass in Zul'Aman and Moroes in Karazhan. All 5 of them must be defeated to beat the encounter. The style of fight is similar to an arena 5v5 match, and somewhat like the alternate Ring of the Law encounter in the Blackrock Depths. According to conversations between Dawnblade blood elves on Quel'Danas, Delrissa was the one who brought Kael'thas Sunstrider back to "health" after his defeat in Tempest Keep. Delrissa is a "memory" in the fight against Argent Confessor Paletress in the Trial of the Champion encounter of the Crusaders' Coliseum.

Prideful is the Shadowlands Season 1 affix for Mythic+. It is applied as a seasonal 4th affix that is added to every Mythic Keystone at level 10 or higher. A Manifestation of Pride spawns at every 20% interval of trash being cleared, at a max of five spawns each dungeon run. Upon killing the manifestation, the players will gain the [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=340880/prideful Prideful] buff which increases their damage and healing by 30%, movement speed by 60% and restoring 5% mana every second for 60 seconds for 1 minute.

Pride's Prison is a section in Castle Nathria, accessed through the Halls of the Faithful. The Sun King's Salvation encounter occurs here. High Torturer Darithos oversees the torture and binding of Kael'thas Sunstrider here. The area contains a massive statue of Sire Denathrius in the center and six prison crystals on the side, where Vile Occultists drain anima from Sinstone Markers. The Accuser leads a band of Maw Walkers to defeat Darithos and his cohorts and to collect Kael'thas.

Primal Chaos was a crafting reagent used to make high-quality gear in several Dragon Isles profession recipes. Primal Chaos can drop from dungeons and open-world content.
Pride and Protodrakes can be found in the Life-Binder Conservatory while on Library of Alexstrasza.
Primal-infused Dragon Egg drops from Kyrakka in the Ruby Life Pools. It can also be looted from the Challenger's Cache.
